name: pajaros-de-cartagena
description: Pájaros de Cartagena que revolotean por Obsidian y el navegador. Basado en Pocket Bird, de Idrees Hassan.
author: Idrees Hassan

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch package.json --watch stylesheet.css --watch build.js --watch obsidian-manifest.json --watch browser-manifest.json --watch sprites/species.png --watch sprites/birds --exec "npm run build"
